text: The evidence is insufficient to confirm whether this asset is deforestation-free. No observations were made due to missing satellite data coverage for this area. The assessment doesn’t support any claims—neither that tree-cover loss occurred nor that it didn’t. Without available data (e.g., Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020, or MGAP 2021), we cannot verify compliance with regulations like EUDR or determine if the asset is deforestation-free. The analysis only covers whole-asset boundaries post-2020, but gaps in data prevent conclusions.
